observations.pre_dispatch_state: At telemetry sequence 1493, the exact Burn and Fish inventories were open. Burn held equipped Katana and Halfpants (ragged); Fish held three other items and had room.
observations.request: Commands cmd-460ee0bb31814fd98e7d7057747348f6 and cmd-2538e63cec614d87a06511aa925f4256 requested exact section-and-slot transfers from Burn to Fish.
observations.acknowledgement: Each command completed with reason item_transferred in the named bundle.
observations.later_engine_evidence: Later open-inventory telemetry showed Burn empty and Fish holding both moved items.
observations.final_disposition: Durably live-proven for inventory-model movement of these two equipped items only.
remaining_uncertainty: The bundle did not record built and installed DLL hashes.
This does not prove shop economics, theft adjudication, or every equipped slot.
